description:
Software and retained numerical results accompanying Walsh-coded and negotiated targets for motor imagery EEG decoding: a controlled evaluation of accuracy and confidence, by Salih Çolakoğlu, Mustafa Onat and Nuri Korhan. Manuscript V4.4 was submitted to the Journal of Neuroscience Methods on 2 October 2026.

The package includes preparation, CSP–CNN and EEGNet training, the CSP–LDA reference, result summarization and verification code, 1,415 retained training records and 800 EEGNet prediction files. The experiments use BNCI2014-001, BNCI2014-002 and BNCI2014-004. Raw EEG recordings and filtered or epoched signal caches are not included; preparation scripts obtain recordings from the providers through MOABB.

Version 2.1.0 updates documentation, attribution, licensing scope and archival metadata. Scientific code and the stored result archive are unchanged from the public v2.0 package. Please cite this software release, the accompanying study and the original dataset publications when applicable.
